listing.name: Digimon World 2003 — dw2003recomp (gascarcella)
listing.summary: Run Digimon World 2003 from your Europe SLES03936 disc with the upstream AppImage or a local source build. A complete campaign, setup and gameplay have not been confirmed by Portcove.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe SLES03936 disc as a single-track MODE2/2352 BIN/CUE image: 692146560 bytes, SHA-1 457cb233349ba841e03b33d8060f8fbcadd45cb3. A 2048-byte-sector ISO is rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for dw2003-<version>-x86_64.AppImage and SHA256SUMS. The launcher selects and checks your disc, then reads it while the game runs. A native source build is also available.

warnings: Upstream reports rebuilding byte-identical executables and overlays from C, with a native game, launcher and mod support. A complete campaign has not been confirmed by Portcove.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
